definitions.explanation: Of considerable size; prenominal adjective form.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧で⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a loud voice.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧がある。
{大|おお}きな⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧が⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧に{大|おお}きな⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧があって、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧は⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: There's a big tree in the garden, so it's cool in summer.

notes:
{大|おお}きな is a pre-noun adjectival ({連体詞|れんたいし}) meaning 'big' or 'large.' It can only appear directly before a noun.

DIFFERENCE FROM ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧:
- {大|おお}きな: only before nouns ({大|おお}きな⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧). Cannot be a predicate.
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: can be used both as a predicate (⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧が{大|おお}きい) and before nouns ({大|おお}きい⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧)

In practice, both forms are interchangeable when modifying nouns, but only ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ can end a sentence.

SIMILAR PAIRS:
- {大|おお}きな / ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: big
- ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧ / ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: small
- おかしな / ⟦おかしい→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧: strange

These な/{連体詞|れんたいし} forms are not na-adjectives — they are a special grammatical class that has only the attributive form.
